verdict.rationale: Docusign does version its REST APIs and publishes OpenAPI specs (docusign-gh-1, docusign-gh-2, docusign-docs-21/22), but no explicit deprecation-policy documentation was found, and a concrete hands-on report describes being forced onto a legacy API version 'with no promise against sunsetting' after a security fix (docusign-comm-1), directly contradicting the idea of a reliable, documented deprecation policy. missing for 10: a published API versioning/deprecation policy page, evidence of advance-notice sunset timelines, and independent corroboration that deprecated versions are handled predictably.
